sources.title: Skip lives when you rebirth
sources.text: Rebirth with far more money than you need and you can skip up to 20 lives at once (turn it on in Settings). You get half the lives you skipped as shards, rounded up.

sources.title: Salvage Reborn items
sources.text: The Craftsman turns Reborn and Advanced Reborn items you don't need into shards. Rarer items give more.

sources.title: Gift of Life
sources.text: A Collectible present from Santa that unwraps into 5 to 15 shards. Handed out in Winter 2020, 2021 and 2025.

uses.title: The Reborn Shop
uses.text: The Craftsman sells 10 random Reborn and Advanced Reborn items a day for shards.

uses.title: Enchanted crafting
uses.text: Every Enchanted recipe at The Craftsman needs shards on top of its items.

uses.title: Platforms
uses.text: Standard, Hydraulic and Mega Platforms in the Premium Shop cost shards, and get pricier with each one you buy.

uses.title: Unstable Conveyor
uses.text: The Masked Man sells it for a single shard.

uses.title: Shard Park & Shard City
uses.text: These upgraders get stronger the more shards you're holding, so saving them pays off.

shop.note: The shop shows 10 random items and resets every day at 12:00 PM UTC, the same time as your daily gift. Items only show up once you're a high enough life to rebirth for them.
shop.quirks: The formulas aren't perfect: Railgun Cannon (Adv. rarity 2), Desert Monument (Reborn rarity 1) and Venomshank (Reborn rarity 3) are priced like the top Advanced Reborns.

Standard Platform.rise: Price goes up with each one you buy
Standard Platform.note: 12×12 and stackable, so you can build a second floor.

Hydraulic Standard Platform.note: Same 12×12 footprint, but you can change its height.

Mega Platform.rise: Price goes up with each one you buy
Mega Platform.note: 20×20, the biggest platform in the game. It was planned as a life 1,000+ rebirth item.

Small Platform.rise: Sold by The Masked Man for uC, not shards

park.parkQuote: Shards of Life are believed to be remnants of Solumn's Soul. However he never perished, so this is a mere myth.
park.parkText: A Reborn upgrader (life 800+, or 400 shards in the Reborn Shop). +0.25x for every shard you hold, up to 10x at 36 shards. With 0 shards it doesn't upgrade at all.
park.cityText: Evolves from 15 Shard Parks at The Craftsman (250k RP blueprint). Multiplies by shards ÷ 4, up to 16x at 64 shards. Careful: at 3 shards or fewer it lowers ore value, and at 0 it does 0x.

warnings: Shards are Reborn-proof: rebirthing never takes them.
They are not Sacrifice-proof. The Second Sacrifice takes all of your shards, and they've been lost on sacrifice since the Reincarnation Update.

history.title: Shards arrive
history.text: Added in the Menu Refresh Update, bought with life skips.

history.title: Platforms
history.text: The New Heights Update sells Standard and Mega Platforms for shards.

history.title: Shard Park
history.text: A Reborn upgrader that scales with your shards.

history.title: Reincarnation
history.text: The Reborn Shop and salvaging arrive. Shards stop being Sacrifice-proof.

trivia: Before the Reincarnation Update, Draedon had miners digging up a meteor on the old map. They said it was made of Shards of Life.
Berezaa once said on Twitter that the Crystal Shrine would cost 300 shards. It ended up as an Advanced Reborn item instead.
Shard Park and Shard City were going to turn pink when shards got a pink redesign, but the developers dropped the change.
The Coliseum Catharsis recipe asks for 753 shards, a nod to 753 BC, the year Rome was founded.
The Sword God Shrine used to cost 200 shards from The Masked Man. It's now an Advanced Reborn for 720.
Spook McDooks claims he skips millions of lives every month, which is why he has so many boxes to spare.
